Summary: Vantage Components, niche industrial supplier.
Evidence: one diligence note referencing OEM contracts, figures unverified.
Gaps: financials, concentration, management depth.
Recommendation: hold — verify contract claims first.

Summary: Northbank Foods, regional staples producer.
Evidence: stable margins but two ownership disputes in event history.
Gaps: dispute resolution status, audited accounts.
Recommendation: hold — legal overhang unresolved.
